Diego (Revenue Ops): Heads-up  Vendor Delta issued a $32,400 credit on INV-2025-2101 (36-month committed SaaS, 2025-07-01 to 2028-06-30). Need treatment for Q1 close.
Hannah Billing: Can you paste vendor note + line-level allocation? Is credit against subscription lines or one-time fees?
Diego (Revenue Ops): Vendor note: 'billing reconciliation credit for invoiced overage on subscription services.' Invoice had Subscription $324,000 (deferred) + Setup $30,000 (one-time). Credit applied at invoice level; billing flagged it to subscription only.
Tom (FP&A): So 10% credit applied to subscription -> new subscription total = 291,600. Recognized so far = 6 months out of 36 (through 2025-12). Recognized monthly = 9,000 originally (324k/36). Recognized portion of credit = 6 * 9,000 * 0.10 = 5,400 already recognized. Remaining 27,000 still in deferral.
Ruth Controller: Language indicates corrective credit for prior overbilling. That suggests a prior-period correction for recognized portion unless vendor clarifies it's a prospective concession. Audit will need vendor evidence.
Diego (Revenue Ops): Vendor email attached in thread (uploader). They used phrase 'reconciliation credit for overcharge'  seems corrective.
AuditTeam: Please include the original invoice PDF and a sample customer communication if any. We'll evaluate whether it meets materiality/disclosure thresholds. Provide the monthly P&L bridge.
Tom (FP&A): Draft impact and JE proposals: If we treat as correction after approval, split entries could be:
```
1) Reverse recognized revenue portion (prior-period correction if required):
DR 4001 Revenue - Subscription    5,400
CR 2100 Cash / AP                 5,400

2) Adjust deferred for remaining credit (prospective/remainder):
DR 2401 Deferred Revenue         27,000
CR 4001 Revenue - Subscription   27,000
```
If we need to avoid changing revenue before CFO/audit sign-off, interim suspense approach: 
```
DR 2401 Deferred Revenue         32,400
CR 9999 Suspense Clearing        32,400
```
Then reverse suspense and post final JEs after approvals.
Ruth Controller: Agreed on suspense for close. Do NOT post revenue-reducing JEs without CFO + Audit alignment. Tom, prepare a one-page restatement memo showing prior-period impact and whether this triggers disclosure (materiality threshold $20k for our policy).
Diego (Revenue Ops): Noted. Billing confirms no corrected invoices will be reissued to the customer. I'll attach their confirmation.
Tom (FP&A): Also flag tax: VAT treatment might require correction of output tax. I'll loop in tax.
AuditTeam: Once memo + evidence uploaded, we'll review. If deemed prior-period correction, we'll coordinate disclosure language. If prospective, we'll re-amortize remaining deferral and update schedules.
revbot: Reminder: month-end cut-off 2026-03-31 17:00 UTC. Any JEs after cut-off require CFO tag and explanation.
Ruth Controller: For close: post the suspense JE only. Tom, upload memo by 09:30 tomorrow and tag @CFO and @AuditTeam.
Diego (Revenue Ops): Will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
